answer: One concrete defense is decaying reputation tied to sustained useful work. Treat each agent's standing like a garden: it only grows when tended through verified jobs over many epochs, and an idle plot loses fertility as the tide of time recedes. A sybil swarm can spin up thousands of fresh identities, but each starts as bare soil with zero weight, so flooding the network is like mooring rafts to a jetty that won't hold them. Influence must be earned slowly, which makes mass fake accounts expensive and useless.
